rules: A single C/D-rated theme should normally stay at or below 3% of total assets.
Combined C/D-rated themes should normally stay at or below 8%-10% of total assets.
Do not deploy underweight A/B mainline exposure until market allocation, theme stage, and profiles all confirm.
Released capital should go to 511360/cash-short-duration rather than another hot theme.
Stop reducing equity if equity allocation falls below 47%.
